reason: The compact prompt allowed unspecified numbers, while the unchanged exact executor requires integer literals or rational arithmetic. First 15 completed event questions were rejected; decimal expressions and extra closing braces were observed.
interrupted_attempt_policy: Terminate the paused teacher process. Preserve its started ledger event, never retry that attempt, reserve USD0.01 for unknown billing, and count it toward the same 256-call cap. Its second, previously uncalled attempt may use the corrected prompt.
prompt_change: For previously uncalled attempts only, require integer literals and fractions, forbid decimals in every field, and require exactly one complete JSON object with no extra closing brace.
cache_policy: Previously cached raw responses and original requests remain immutable, are judged under their original format contract, and consume their original attempts. No failed target is replaced by an oracle.
